rules.statement: Two dots are adjacent iff max(|dx|,|dy|)==1 in grid coords (8-directional).
IsLegalMove checks in order: adjacent -> edge not exists -> no crossing -> not through claimed area.
A shared endpoint between two segments is not a crossing.
A drag commits a line only on pointer release; returning to the start dot cancels.
The current player moves again iff at least one scorable face was claimed this move.
A face with more than 4 boundary dots is not filled or scored.
A face enclosing a free grid point is unfinished: not filled or scored.
A face classified Unknown is not filled or scored (kept splittable).
A real face has signed area > 0 in grid coords; the outer face is negative and discarded.
A move is illegal only if it enters a claimed region's interior; grazing a border is allowed.
The game ends when no legal move remains.
Shape definitions are tried in priority order; first Matches wins (Square, Parallelogram, AcuteTriangle, RightTriangle, Unknown).
Boundary is ordered by angle and simplified (collinear removed) before shape matching.

steps: InputController.Update reads primary pointer (touch else mouse).
TickIdle: press over a dot (not UI) -> Pressed, originPoint set, highlight.
TickPressed: move > dragThresholdPixels -> Dragging, CancelSelection, ShowPreview.
UpdateDrag: on start dot -> cancel target; else snap nearest legal neighbor in commit zone -> currentTarget; preview.
HandleDragRelease: commit currentTarget (or dot under finger fallback) via TryCommitLine; null -> cancel.
Quick tap -> HandleQuickTap -> GameManager.OnPointClicked.
One click per frame (lastClickFrame).
No selection -> select firstPoint; same dot -> deselect; different dot -> TryCommitLine.
TryCommitLine: reject via LogRejection if !IsLegalMove.
CommitLine: DrawLine, edges.Add, RegisterEdge.
FindAllNewClosedShapes -> up to two bounded faces.
Per face: skip if Count>4, EnclosesGridPoint, Unknown, or already closed; else score + ClaimRegion.
Haptic: shape buzz if any shape closed else line buzz.
SwitchPlayer only if no shape closed.
EndGame if !AnyLegalMoveRemains.
Trace both sides of the new edge: TraceFace(b,a) and TraceFace(a,b).
At each vertex take the next-clockwise neighbor via GetSortedNeighborsByAngle.
TryAddFace keeps faces with signed area > 0, not already closed, and not duplicate.
MainMenu.Start wires sliders/icons.
OnStartGameClicked writes GameSettings.BoardWidth/Height, LoadScene Game.
GameManager.Awake: Instance, HumanPlayers, add InputController + HapticFeedback.
BoardGenerator.Start: read GameSettings, GenerateGrid, publish GridBounds, add + call CameraFitter.Fit.
